title: Justin Bieber Adds to ‘Swag’ Collection With Live Coachella Album: Stream It Now
summary: Swag Live From Coachella (Weekend I) features guest spots from The Kid LAROI, Tems, Wizkid, Dijon, and Mk.gee, and stretches across 22 tracks.
contentText:
There’s more Justin Bieber Swag for your collection.

At the stroke of midnight, the Canadian pop star shared the full live recording from his much-talked-about headlining performance at the 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts festival, on April 11.

Released through Def Jam Recordings , Swag Live From Coachella (Weekend I) features guest spots from The Kid LAROI, Tems, Wizkid, Dijon, and Mk.gee, and stretches across 22 tracks.

It’s the companion to a performance that spurred its share of conversation on social media after Bieber spent some of the set playing and singing along to old YouTube videos of his catalog alongside his more recent hits. Whatever, it generated an impressive spike for Bieber’s streams, new and older. Following that first weekend slot, Bieber landed seven albums on the Billboard 200 at the same time , a career best for the most titles on the tally concurrently. Prior to that, the most he had on the chart at once was four, last achieved in January 2012.

Swag Live From Coachella (Weekend I) follows the Grammy Award-nominated seventh studio album Swag , which dropped July 11, 2025, debuted at No. 2 on the  Billboard 200  (dated July 26), and flooded the Billboard Hot 100 chart with 16 songs, led by “Daisies” at No. 2.  His first LP in four years, since  Justice , Swag  debuted at No. 1 on Top Streaming Albums while the album track “Daisies” started at No. 1 on Top Streaming Songs. 

Then, last September, the surprise release of Swag II , which opened and peaked at No. 4 on the all-genres Billboard 200 list.

Missed it? The official livestream of Bieber’s performance on Thursday, June 25 enjoyed a special encore repeat on YouTube, and will repeat again today, June 26 at 7pm ET .
